## ConnectionsModule.acceptInvitation() method

Accept a connection invitation as invitee (by sending a connection request message) for the connection with the specified connection id. This is not needed when auto accepting of connections is enabled.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
acceptInvitation(connectionId: string, config?: {
        autoAcceptConnection?: boolean;
    }): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                | Description                                                 |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| connectionId | string                              | the id of the connection for which to accept the invitation |
| config       | { autoAcceptConnection?: boolean; } | <i>(Optional)</i>                                           |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ConnectionRecord](./core.connectionrecord.md)&gt;

connection record
